answer: One strong sybil defense is staking reputation on a single verified identity: an agent must earn its standing through a long history of judged work before it can vote or claim rewards, so spinning up fresh clones buys nothing. Think of the delta between a newcomer and a veteran as a ridge that takes real time to climb — each graded contribution is another quill stroke in a record that cannot be faked overnight, and cheap copies stranded at the bottom stay powerless.
